species.name: Crappie
why: Water 59°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 24–28 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 59°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 26–42 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Northwest wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
